raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Bumps [transformers](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers) from 5.16.1 to 5.20.2.
Release notes

Sourced from transformers's releases.

Patch release v5.20.2

Patch release: v5.20.2

This patch notably solves an issue where some inputs could loose their original type inside prepare_inputs_for_generation in generate, leading to problems with multimodal models. It also fixes some other issues listed on the below commits.

It contains the following commits:

  • Fix inputs dict casting in generate (#49731) by @​Cyrilvallez
  • Fix zero expert gradients in bfloat16 with expert parallelism and ep_size < fsdp_size (#49688) by @​qgallouedec
  • Declare the input modalities of the VLMs that report text only (#49677) by @​qgallouedec
  • Avoid a host-to-device copy in eager_mask (#49684) by @​hmellor

Release v5.20.1

Special surprise including the new model Beam from Reflection AI :partying_face:

Beam is a token-efficient, frontier-scale model focused on coding and agentic use cases. It is built for teams that want to run a powerful model on their own hardware, infrastructure, or cloud, and customize it to their specific needs.

Links: Documentation

  • Fix small bug in auto mappings (#49664) by @​yonigozlan in #49664

Some real patch fixes

We broke loading models on older torch versions :cry: should be fixed now. But here is the full list of fixes

  • Fix HunYuan-VL image assignment during batched generation (#49557) by @​Arnav66692
  • Fix DeepGEMM Mega MoE under expert parallelism(#49428) by @​IlyasMoutawwakil
  • Fix from_pretrained on torch 2.7: require torch>=2.8 for distributed checkpointing (#49652) by @​naveecode
  • Make DtensorShardOperation work on torch 2.6 and 2.7 (#49657) by @​hazelxue

Full Changelog: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/compare/v5.20.0...v5.20.1

Release v5.20.0

New Model additions

Muse Spark Open

Muse Spark Open is a multimodal mixture-of-experts model from Meta that takes text, images, audio, and video as input and generates text. It has 816B total parameters (42B active per token) and a context window of up to 1,048,576 tokens shared across modalities. It is trained for agentic coding tasks such as multi-file editing, debugging, and tool use. Checkpoints are available in BF16 and NVFP4 formats.

Links: Documentation | Blog Post

  • Add Muse Spark Open (#49644) by @​guarin in #49644

  • 0ea8779 v5.20.1

  • 759c538 Make DtensorShardOperation work on torch 2.6 and 2.7 (#49657)

detail.title: build(deps): bump transformers from 5.16.1 to 5.20.2

files.patch:
@@ -97,7 +97,7 @@ vllm = [
     # wheelhouse so vllm can select its compatible version.
     # transformers 5.16.1 is the project-wide pin (enforced in
     # override-dependencies below).
-    "transformers==5.16.1",
+    "transformers==5.20.2",
 ]
 
 sglang = [
@@ -115,7 +115,7 @@ sglang = [
     # flash-attn 2.8.3 the training extras pin — see override-dependencies); it is
     # imported lazily (fa4 backend only), so the default backends work.
     # sglang's transformers requirement is settled by the project-wide override.
-    "transformers==5.16.1",
+    "transformers==5.20.2",
 ]
 
 # DEFERRED — trtllm is a CUDA-13 backend (torch 2.10.0+cu130, conflict-gated).
@@ -249,7 +249,7 @@ cpu = [
     "torch==2.13.0",
     "torchvision==0.28.0",
     "torchaudio==2.11.0",
-    "transformers==5.16.1",
+    "transformers==5.20.2",
     # Plain source package (torch / numpy / packaging + one pybind11 C++ ext, no
     # CUDA toolchain), and it imports without TE / apex — both are optional there
     # with pure-torch fallbacks. It is what lets the `*_on_cpu.py` tests that
@@ -393,7 +393,7 @@ conflicts = [
 ]
 
 # Global override pins:
-#   * transformers==5.16.1 project-wide — one version for every backend, so a
+#   * transformers==5.20.2 project-wide — one version for every backend, so a
 #     venv's transformers no longer depends on which engine it was synced with.
 #     Unmarked on purpose: overrides are absolute and replace EVERY requirement
 #     on the package, so this also settles the engines' own pins. Keep it inside
@@ -422,7 +422,7 @@ conflicts = [
 #     non-default "fa4" attention backend.
 override-dependencies = [
     "tilelang==0.1.15",
-    "transformers==5.16.1",
+    "transformers==5.20.2",
     "tokenizers==0.23.2",
     "numpy>=2.0.0",
     "kernels>=0.14.1,<0.15",

@@ -17,7 +17,7 @@ tensordict>=0.8.0,<=0.10.0,!=0.9.0
 torchdata
 # 5.6.0 ships a broken flash-attention path (crashes on s_aux=None for sink-less
 # models like Qwen2/Llama); fixed in 5.6.1. See huggingface/transformers#45588.
-transformers>=5.5.3,!=5.6.0,<5.17
+transformers>=5.5.3,!=5.6.0,<5.21
 wandb
 packaging>=20.0
 uvicorn
